You are an agent who can operate an Android phone on behalf of a user. Based on user's goal/request, you may
- Answer back if the request/goal is a question (or a chat message), like user asks "What is my schedule for today?".
- Complete some tasks described in the requests/goals by performing actions (step by step) on the phone.

When given a user request, you will try to complete it step by step. At each step, a list of descriptions for most UI elements on the current screen will be given to you (each element can be specified by an index), together with a history of what you have done in previous steps. Based on these pieces of information and the goal, you must choose to perform one of the action in the following list (action description followed by the JSON format) by outputing the action in the correct JSON format.
- If you think the task has been completed, finish the task by using the status action with complete as goal_status: `{"action_type": "status", "goal_status": "complete"}`
- If you think the task is not feasible (including cases like you don't have enough information or can not perform some necessary actions), finish by using the `status` action with infeasible as goal_status: `{"action_type": "status", "goal_status": "infeasible"}`
- Answer user's question: `{"action_type": "answer", "text": "<answer_text>"}`
- Click/tap on a UI element (specified by its index) on the screen: `{"action_type": "click", "index": <target_index>}`.
- Long press on a UI element (specified by its index) on the screen: `{"action_type": "long_press", "index": <target_index>}`.
- Type text into an editable text field (specified by its index), this action contains clicking the text field, typing in the text and pressing the enter, so no need to click on the target field to start: `{"action_type": "input_text", "text": <text_input>, "index": <target_index>}`
- Press the Enter key: `{"action_type": "keyboard_enter"}`
- Navigate to the home screen: `{"action_type": "navigate_home"}`
- Navigate back: `{"action_type": "navigate_back"}`
- Scroll the screen or a scrollable UI element in one of the four directions, use the same numeric index as above if you want to scroll a specific UI element, leave it empty when scroll the whole screen: `{"action_type": "scroll", "direction": <up, down, left, right>, "index": <optional_target_index>}`
- Open an app (nothing will happen if the app is not installed): `{"action_type": "open_app", "app_name": <name>}`
- Wait for the screen to update: `{"action_type": "wait"}`

The current user goal/request is: Add the recipes from recipes.jpg in Simple Gallery Pro to the Broccoli recipe app.

Here is a history of what you have done so far:
Step 1: Action selected: {"action_type": "open_app", "app_name": "Simple Gallery Pro"}. Tried to open Simple Gallery Pro to view recipes.jpg, but the screen still shows the home screen - the app may not have launched yet or needs more time; should wait or try again.
Step 2: Action selected: {"action_type": "open_app", "app_name": "Simple Gallery Pro"}. Attempted to open Simple Gallery Pro app, but the screen remained on the home launcher - the app did not launch, suggesting it may not be installed or the open_app action failed; should try tapping the app icon directly or searching for it in the app drawer.
Step 3: Action selected: {"action_type": "scroll", "direction": "up"}. Tried to scroll up on the home screen to open the app drawer to find Simple Gallery Pro, but instead it opened the quick settings/notification panel (showing Wifi, Bluetooth toggles). Need to navigate back and try a different approach like using open_app action or swiping up from the bottom of home screen.
Step 4: Action selected: {"action_type": "navigate_back"}. Navigated back from the quick settings panel to the home screen; next I should open Simple Gallery Pro to view recipes.jpg.
Step 5: Action selected: {"action_type": "open_app", "app_name": "Simple Gallery Pro"}. Attempted to open Simple Gallery Pro via open_app action, but the screen remained on the home launcher - the app did not launch, possibly because the app name doesn't match exactly. Next, try tapping the Search bar to find the app, or swipe up to open the app drawer to locate Simple Gallery Pro.
Step 6: Action selected: {"action_type": "open_app", "app_name": "Simple Gallery"}. Tried to open "Simple Gallery" via open_app action, but the screen remained on the home screen with no change, suggesting the app name didn't match any installed app; should try opening the app manually by finding it in the app drawer or use a different name variant.
Step 7: Some error happened executing the action open_app
Step 8: Action selected: {"action_type": "scroll", "direction": "down"}. Scrolled down (swiped up) from the home screen to open the app drawer; it worked and I can see apps listed alphabetically, but Simple Gallery Pro is not visible yet—need to scroll down within the app drawer to find it.
Step 9: Action selected: {"action_type": "scroll", "direction": "down", "index": 0}. Scrolled down in the app drawer to find Simple Gallery Pro; the list shifted showing apps now starting from AndroidWorld at the top through YT Music, but Simple Gallery Pro is still not visible - may need to scroll further or it may not be installed.
Step 10: Action selected: {"action_type": "input_text", "text": "gallery", "index": 2}. Searched "gallery" in the app drawer search bar; search results appeared but none are clearly visible as Simple Gallery Pro yet - should scroll or check results, or alternatively use open_app action directly with "Simple Gallery Pro" name.
Step 11: Action selected: {"action_type": "click", "index": 3}. Clicked the "Clear search box" button (index 3) to clear "gallery" search text; the search field is now empty showing app suggestions (SMS Messenger, Calendar, Markor, Clipper) instead of gallery results, confirming Simple Gallery Pro may not be found by that name—next I should try open_app with "Simple Gallery Pro" directly or search for "Files"/"Photos".
Step 12: Action selected: {"action_type": "open_app", "app_name": "Simple Gallery Pro"}. Attempted to open "Simple Gallery Pro" via open_app, but screen remained unchanged (still on launcher with search/keyboard open), indicating the app is likely not installed or not recognized by that exact name; should try alternative names like "Gallery" or use Files app to locate recipes.jpg.
Step 13: Action selected: {"action_type": "navigate_back"}. Navigated back from the search/keyboard screen to the app drawer, which shows all installed apps (AndroidWorld, Audio Recorder, Broccoli, Calendar, Camera, Chrome, Clipper, Clock, Contacts, Drive, Files, Gmail, Google, Maps, Markor, Messages, Phone, Photos, Pro Expense, Settings, SMS Messenger, TMoble, YouTube) - notably Simple Gallery Pro is NOT in this list, so it may not be installed; should try opening it via open_app action or use Files/Photos app instead to view recipes.jpg.
